identificationModule.briefTitle: Nexavar® Versus Placebo in Locally Advanced/Metastatic RAI-Refractory Differentiated Thyroid Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Double-Blind Randomized Phase III Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Sorafenib Compared to Placebo in Locally Advanced/Metastatic RAI-Refractory Differentiated Thyroid Cancer

armGroups.label: Sorafenib (Nexavar, BAY43-9006)
armGroups.description: Participants received 2 tablets of Sorafenib (2×200 mg) orally twice daily (12 hours apart without food), 28 days comprise a cycle

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants received 2 tablets of Sorafenib-matching placebo orally twice daily (12 hours apart without food), 28 days comprise a cycle

interventions.name: Sorafenib (Nexavar, BAY43-9006)
interventions.description: Sorafenib 400 mg will be administered orally, twice daily (approximately every 12 hours).

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo (2 tablets) will be administered orally, twice daily (approximately every 12 hours).
